# recorded no later than

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:recordedNoLaterThan`](gmeow-recordedNoLaterThan.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/recordedNoLaterThan>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)

A DERIVED upper bound (terminus ante quem) on when the annotated claim was committed to a record — typically taken from the modification time of its source carrier ([`gmeow:sourceModifiedAt`](gmeow-sourceModifiedAt.md)) when no stronger observation time is known. Carries low [`gmeow:confidence`](gmeow-confidence.md); it is neither valid-time nor a point observation. Populate it in the importer/query layer, not by OWL inference.

## Structure

**Property shape:** annotation property; `?` -> [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:recordedNoLaterThan`](gmeow-recordedNoLaterThan.md) from `?` to [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
